revision_binding.reason: Tracked content cannot embed its own containing commit without circular identity.

content.heading: Applicability and Selection
content.purpose: Select the minimum sufficient governed MRD set for the actual repository need rather than instantiating the full catalog by default.

selection_order: identify the governed fact, decision, workflow, configuration, contract, prompt, evaluation, evidence, or derived view
match the need to an existing MRD type by function
apply the type trigger and select only the minimum sufficient artifacts
bind each selected artifact to its canonical owner and dependencies
record required gaps or justified deferrals before implementation
propose a catalog amendment only when no existing type can represent the need

type_applicability.name: Entity definition schema
type_applicability.use_when: Use when a governed domain needs a canonical entity shape, identity, fields, or structural definition.

type_applicability.name: Enumeration schema
type_applicability.use_when: Use when a finite controlled vocabulary or closed set of allowed values must be authoritative.

type_applicability.name: Ontology
type_applicability.use_when: Use when governed concepts and their semantic relationships need an explicit ontology.

type_applicability.name: Registry
type_applicability.use_when: Use when named governed entries require one authoritative registry with stable identifiers.

type_applicability.name: Domain definition register
type_applicability.use_when: Use when a domain boundary, scope, vocabulary ownership, or domain definition must be registered.

type_applicability.name: Assertion rules
type_applicability.use_when: Use when invariants or semantic assertions must be stated independently of implementation code.

type_applicability.name: Version constraint
type_applicability.use_when: Use when allowed, required, minimum, maximum, or compatible versions must be constrained.

type_applicability.name: Boundary rule
type_applicability.use_when: Use when an authority, security, filesystem, network, module, or responsibility boundary must be constrained.

type_applicability.name: Policy implementation
type_applicability.use_when: Use when durable policy determines what is permitted, prohibited, required, or conditionally allowed.

type_applicability.name: Constraint contract
type_applicability.use_when: Use when constraints themselves require a reusable machine-consumable contract.

type_applicability.name: Decision table
type_applicability.use_when: Use when an outcome can be selected deterministically from a finite set of conditions in tabular form.

type_applicability.name: Decision tree
type_applicability.use_when: Use when ordered or branching conditions determine a governed outcome more clearly than a table.

type_applicability.name: Scoring model
type_applicability.use_when: Use when weighted criteria or scores determine a governed classification, threshold, or decision.

type_applicability.name: State machine
type_applicability.use_when: Use when governed state, permitted transitions, and terminal states must be explicit.

type_applicability.name: Process definition
type_applicability.use_when: Use when a repeatable ordered process with defined inputs, steps, and outputs must be prescribed.

type_applicability.name: Approval workflow
type_applicability.use_when: Use when approval, rejection, escalation, or sign-off flow must be governed.

type_applicability.name: Phase contract
type_applicability.use_when: Use when a workflow phase requires explicit entry, exit, handoff, or completion conditions.

type_applicability.name: Workflow definition
type_applicability.use_when: Use when several governed steps, roles, decisions, or phases form an end-to-end workflow.

type_applicability.name: Action or automation workflow
type_applicability.use_when: Use when a bounded action or automation sequence must be executable under governance.

type_applicability.name: Environment config
type_applicability.use_when: Use when environment-specific values select allowed behavior without redefining policy.

type_applicability.name: Feature flag
type_applicability.use_when: Use when a governed feature can be enabled or disabled through an explicit flag.

type_applicability.name: Runtime parameter
type_applicability.use_when: Use when a runtime parameter selects among already-permitted behaviors or limits.

type_applicability.name: Field mapping
type_applicability.use_when: Use when fields in one governed structure translate deterministically to fields in another.

type_applicability.name: Format translation
type_applicability.use_when: Use when one representation or serialization format must translate deterministically to another.

type_applicability.name: Migration map
type_applicability.use_when: Use when a versioned structure, identifier, or data model requires an explicit migration mapping.

type_applicability.name: API contract
type_applicability.use_when: Use when callable request/response behavior requires an explicit API interface contract.

type_applicability.name: Event contract
type_applicability.use_when: Use when produced or consumed events require stable names, payloads, and delivery semantics.

type_applicability.name: Service contract
type_applicability.use_when: Use when a service boundary, capability, inputs, outputs, or service-level interface must be contracted.

type_applicability.name: Package manifest
type_applicability.use_when: Use when a package's governed identity, contents, dependencies, or distribution metadata must be declared.

type_applicability.name: Bill of materials
type_applicability.use_when: Use when constituent components or dependencies must be inventoried as a bill of materials.

type_applicability.name: Release manifest
type_applicability.use_when: Use when a release needs an authoritative manifest of version, contents, provenance, and release facts.

type_applicability.name: Skill manifest
type_applicability.use_when: Use when a reusable skill package needs a governed capability and asset manifest.

type_applicability.name: Action manifest
type_applicability.use_when: Use when available actions or automations must be inventoried separately from their workflow definitions.

type_applicability.name: System prompt
type_applicability.use_when: Use when durable system-level model instructions are governed as an explicit prompt artifact.

type_applicability.name: Role prompt
type_applicability.use_when: Use when a durable role-specific behavior or responsibility prompt must be governed.

type_applicability.name: Context prompt
type_applicability.use_when: Use when reusable context assembly or context framing instructions must be governed.

type_applicability.name: Tool prompt
type_applicability.use_when: Use when model-facing instructions for invoking or interpreting a tool must be governed.

type_applicability.name: Test suite
type_applicability.use_when: Use when deterministic or machine-evaluable conformance tests define acceptance of governed behavior.

type_applicability.name: Rubric
type_applicability.use_when: Use when qualitative or multi-criterion review requires an explicit scoring or assessment rubric.

type_applicability.name: Benchmark
type_applicability.use_when: Use when comparable performance, quality, or capability measurement requires a stable benchmark.

type_applicability.name: Log
type_applicability.use_when: Use when an immutable operational or governance log is itself required evidence.

type_applicability.name: Approval record
type_applicability.use_when: Use when an approval decision must be retained as evidence distinct from the approval workflow.

type_applicability.name: Lineage record
type_applicability.use_when: Use when lineage, derivation, handoff, or provenance events must be retained as evidence.

type_applicability.name: Test result snapshot
type_applicability.use_when: Use when a test or verification result must be retained as an immutable evidence snapshot.

type_applicability.name: Index
type_applicability.use_when: Generate when consumers need a derived index over governed artifacts; never author it as primary truth.

type_applicability.name: Dependency map
type_applicability.use_when: Generate when consumers need a derived dependency graph or map; never author it as primary truth.

type_applicability.name: Metadata map
type_applicability.use_when: Generate when consumers need derived metadata joins or lookup maps; never author it as primary truth.

rules.statement: A repository or change MUST NOT instantiate all 47 MRD types by default; it MUST select only types whose applicability conditions are satisfied.
Selection MUST classify the governed need by function before considering file location, technology, framework, or current implementation shape.
When several types could represent the same need, the minimum sufficient non-duplicative set MUST be selected and each governed fact MUST retain one canonical owner.
A required applicability trigger with no selected or existing canonical artifact MUST be reported as a governance gap before dependent implementation is accepted.

A technology or stack change, including adoption of tools such as uv, MUST first be represented using existing functional types such as version constraints, configuration, package manifests, contracts, or workflows when those types are sufficient.
A new MRD type MAY be proposed only when the need cannot be represented without semantic distortion by any existing type, and the proposal MUST enter through a versioned governance amendment.
